data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 193.5m (2017: GBP 140.2m) is an improvement of GBP 9.6m (2017: deterioration of GBP 19.1m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments across the significant classes.

named_events.loss_description: Lower exposure to catastrophe losses in 2018, reduction in catastrophe activity and a lower incidence of large losses.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall profit of GBP 2.4m for the financial year, an improvement of GBP 34.0m from the previous year. This was attributed to lower exposure to catastrophe losses in 2018 and re-underwriting efforts. Net claims ratio decreased due to reduced catastrophe activity and lower incidence of large losses, with favourable experience in Cyber, Political Risks, Excess Casualty, and Energy classes. However, this was partially offset by adverse experience in discontinued Marine classes. The 2015 year of account closed with a loss of GBP 19.4m, and the 2016 year of account was reinsured to close at a loss of GBP 3.9m. Due to the reinsurance to close of the 2016 year of account, a reliable gross prior year development figure cannot be extracted from the claims development triangle, and narrative figures are contradictory or net.

data.data_quality_notes: The report states a net improvement of GBP 9.6m to prior year claims reserves (page 32), but the 'Year of account result development' table (page 39) implies a net strengthening of GBP 0.246m from prior years. The 2016 year of account was reinsured to close (page 6, 8, 42), which distorts the claims development triangle for prior years, making it unreliable for calculating organic prior year development. Due to these contradictions and the RITC distortion, a reliable gross prior year development figure cannot be extracted.
